cases.prompt: Choose layouts for a GitHub review request with a long title, Slack setup required, remaining quota, an authentication failure, and CPU/memory/network. Give coordinates, complete copy, product colors, and a reason for each choice.
expected: Use product mark plus headline/context, product mark plus message, measured progress, exception takeover, and conditional three-row telemetry respectively.
Reserve 54px after a 16px stock mark and 2px gap; explain close-range limits of telemetry.
Use GitHub and Slack identity colors; keep setup, failure, notification reason, and action in familiar language.
forbidden: Offer generic hierarchy advice without a layout or coordinates.
Require an external article to choose a layout.
Replace product identity with the fallback palette or invent codes such as GH, SLK, NTFN, or AUTH.
cases.notes: Fresh-agent behavioral execution is not recorded. See review-results.md for the separate local walkthrough and executable checks.

cases.prompt: Use an existing 16x16 product mark with a 120px notification title, a fixed reason, and 18px/s scrolling. Someone suggests a mandatory 2px icon margin or abbreviating the title.
expected: Use the full-height icon recipe or explicitly redraw a smaller icon.
Keep the reason or another familiar anchor visible; budget about 3.7 seconds of movement plus pauses for a 54px viewport.
Measure the actual font and preserve the complete title with a marquee, second row, back detail, or changed layout.
forbidden: Silently crop or scale the stock icon.
Invent an abbreviation merely to avoid marquee.
cases.notes: Fresh-agent behavioral execution is not recorded. See review-results.md for the separate local walkthrough and executable checks.

cases.prompt: Design a value that changes from 9% to 100%, includes a negative quantity in another state, and uses a locale whose ellipsis glyph is missing.
expected: Reserve measured width and fixed numeric anchors.
Preserve signs/units and choose an explicit supported rewrite for the missing glyph.
Distinguish advance width, ink bounds, and API anchors.
forbidden: Substitute a host font while claiming native fidelity.

cases.prompt: Design a running operation, stale data, offline, and a failure that arrives during a success cue. Include normal motion and a static alternative.
expected: Keep the state readable at arbitrary frames and without color.
Stop obsolete success motion, show failure promptly, and use source-specific freshness.
Do not imply runtime reduced-motion configuration exists without support.
forbidden: Treat a loader as proof of a healthy source.
Prescribe a universal safe brightness or flash frequency.
